headings.usage: Use for all page titles, dashboard metrics, and large UI text.

body.usage: Use for tables, forms, and general UI text.

rules: Use High-Contrast 'Swiss Brutalist' inspired styling: Stark white backgrounds, sharp 1px borders, solid black text.
Cashier actions (Scan/Redeem) must use highly visible colors (Emerald Green).
Avoid soft gradients. Use solid colors.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat surfaces with sharp 1px borders. Subtlest shadow-sm only on hover.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-lg for most components to maintain a clean modern feel.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous on admin (p-6, p-8), compact but large tap-targets on Cashier mode.
visual_enhancers.thermal_print: STRICT B/W. No grayscales, no shadows, no rounded corners. 80mm width max (approx 300px for web preview).

layouts.admin_dashboard: Bento Grid style for statistics. Sidebar navigation. High density data tables.
layouts.cashier_mode: Mobile-first, full screen interface. Massive buttons (min-h-16), large typography for quick scanning/input in fast-paced environment.
layouts.thermal_print_layout: Center aligned. 300px fixed width container. High contrast black text on white.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). Huge touch targets for cashier mode.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Big text inside for easy readability on mobile.
components.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for clean, consistent UI icons.

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200), NO transition-all.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders for data fetching. Spinner for quick actions like Redeem.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum) across all text.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements, especially in Cashier mode.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-btn').

auth_background.placement: Background image for the split-screen Admin/Cashier login page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js/jsx files ONLY, NO .tsx files).
Use Shadcn UI components for complex UI (tables, dropdowns, forms) and customize them to fit the High-Contrast clean theme.
Ensure 'sonner' is used for all toast notifications (success/error during scan/redeem).
CASHIER MODE MUST BE MOBILE-FIRST. Big buttons, camera scanner area prominently displayed, manual PIN/Code entry as fallback.

THERMAL PRINT MODE: Create a specific hidden or printable component structured for 80mm (approx 300px wide). Use @media print to hide everything else and only show the voucher with black/white styling.
The interface text must be in Bahasa Indonesia as requested.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays. Always use solid colors or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur + opacity).
CRITICAL: Center aligning the entire app (.App { text-align: center; }) is FORBIDDEN.
CRITICAL: Ensure every button, input, and interactive component has a relevant data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' design. Create depth, use overlapping elements if necessary, but keep it clean and functional.
Do not use universal 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons.
Use generous spacing for the Admin dashboard to prevent a cramped look, but keep Cashier mode compact and highly accessible.
Include micro-interactions for hover, active, and focus states.
